title: In dire need of custom Mickey Mouse and Winnie the Pooh.

posts.author: ElvenNeko
posts.body:
Resource Type:
(Characters, faces)
Maker Format:
(MV)
Makers I Own:
(XP,VX,MV)
Art Style:
(Any, but would prefer simillar to maker's default)
Description:
Both of those characters should be based on the public domain versions - this is extremply important for them to not have elements that the modern, copyrighted versions of those characters have (like gloves for Mickey). If you need, i can provide images of both public domain and modern ones.
I need both character and portrait, but if you can do one of those - it will be fine as well.
Pooh's face should looks simillar to Xi Jinping, chinese leader (but not exact copy, it should still look a bit like Pooh as well). If possible, have two emotions - friendly smile and triumphant evil stare.
Mickey also requires two states - static smile + empty stare is the first one, the second - crazy stare, mouth opened, revealing circles upon circles of sharp teeths, like this:
https://www.pngfind.com/pngs/m/548-5480129_mouth-creepy-circle-hd-png-download.png
Any extra emotions at your discretion. Would be cool for Pooh to have the damaged face revealing electronics inside with red glowing eye (like terminator), but that is non-essential, do it if you want to.
Now about the reward.
1) Advertising your game(s) in my game in form of an NPC character who will say whatever you want upon interaction + maybe some commentary from the protagonist or the narrator of the game. I can hotfix that into the game so you won't have to wait until i finish the big update (it will take a lot of time).
2) Narrative consultation or assistance. Can review your plot summary, write a character or lore details, etc.
3) Help with generative services (audio, animation and visual) - just keep in mind that it is not allowed to distribute those on this forums, so you will have to give other ways to contact you if you need that.
4) Game key(s).
5) Translate or proofread of small amount of text to russian or ukrainian. Will not have time to translate entire game, but can take reasonably sized request.
Of course, you will also take place in the credits, but unlike things offered above that might have to wait until release of the expansion.
